_note: Item constraint fixtures for the optimiser (P0-T10). Each entry in `item_constraints` maps field-for-field to an `item_constraints` row / the ItemConstraints struct (crates/core/src/domain.rs). The constraint POLICY lives on the canonical item (canonical_items.default_constraint_policy), NOT here, so there is no constraint_policy field. `canonical_item_id` references the real hashed id from fixtures/canonical_items.json: 'dish soap' (washing-up liquid) for the Fairy brand example, and 'whole milk' for the size example. `allowed_brands`, `excluded_brands` and `dietary_flags` are stored but NOT enforced in Phase 0 (Backlog-T1); only `brand` (when the canonical item's policy is 'brand') and `preferred_size_*` (±20% band) are enforced. The Fairy entry is the brand-constrained example required by the issue: with brand='Fairy', own-label washing-up liquid is excluded and only Fairy products are priced.
